primary.title: On the Strong Davenport Constant of Nonabelian Finite p-Groups
primary.author: Vesselin Dimitrov

decisive_observed_text.literal: Applying our methods, we prove our main result which is the strong version of the Erdős-Ginzburg-Ziv theorem for arbitrary finite p-groups, answering in the affirmative a conjecture of Olson in the special case of p-groups.
In this paper, we prove Olson’s conjecture in the case of all finite p-groups. In fact, we establish a more precise result:

decisive_observed_text.transcription: Let G be any finite non-cyclic p-group of order n and let s >= (1+(2p−1)/p²)n−1 be an integer. Then, for any elements g1,...,gs in G, there exist n ordered indices i1<...<in such that g_(i1)...g_(in)=1. Further quantitative Frattini-rank refinement is stated there; Main has not audited its proof.
